import os

IN_PATH = "./data/app.log"
OUT_PATH = "./out/levels.txt"


def main():
    counts = {"ERROR": 0, "WARN": 0, "INFO": 0}

    with open(IN_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape", newline="") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.rstrip("\n")
            idx = line.find(" ")
            level = line if idx == -1 else line[:idx]
            if level in counts:
                counts[level] += 1

    E = counts["ERROR"]
    W = counts["WARN"]
    I = counts["INFO"]

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(f"ERROR={E}\n")
        f.write(f"WARN={W}\n")
        f.write(f"INFO={I}\n")

    if E >= 1:
        print(f"alert not sent: {E} errors")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
